name: Armor Vest
rules: Reduce this hit’s damage by 4, unless the weapon pierces armor.
quip: Not invincible. Just harder to kill.
short: Reduce this hit’s damage by 4 unless armor is pierced.

name: Shield Plate
rules: Halve this hit’s damage to you, rounding down.
quip: Consider this a barrier to communication.
short: Halve this hit’s damage, rounding down.

name: Brace
quip: Brace for impact. This part hurts.

name: Dodge
rules: Cancel this hit’s damage to you. Grenade splash still hits other players.
quip: The best armor is not being there.
short: Cancel this hit’s damage to you.

name: Counterattack
rules: Take this hit’s damage, then deal 3 damage to the attacker.
short: Take this hit, then deal 3 damage to the attacker.

name: Smoke Bomb
rules: Cancel this hit’s damage to you. Until your next turn, attacks and targeted abilities cannot choose you. Splash, events, and Ricochet still affect you.
quip: Nothing to see. That’s the point.
short: Cancel this hit; prevent direct targeting until your next turn.

name: Ricochet
rules: Redirect this hit to another opponent, or back to the attacker if no other is available. Smoke offers no protection. No further Ricochets.
quip: A sharp turn for the worse.
short: Redirect this hit to another opponent, or the attacker if no other is available.

name: Backfire
rules: Cancel this hit’s damage to you. Deal that much damage to the attacker.
quip: That blew up in your face. Literally.
short: Cancel this hit; deal that damage to the attacker.

name: Revive
rules: When damage would eliminate you, discard this card and all non-healing cards. Recover at 1 health until your next turn.
short: Automatically survive lethal damage. Recover at 1 health until your next turn.
